text: {"user":"I’m putting together a birthday gift basket for my sister—she loves coffee and skincare. I already picked up a bag of her favorite beans, a fancy facial cleanser, and I’m debating whether to add a “coffee body scrub” kit I saw online or keep the basket simple with just one extra small item. Any thoughts on how to decide what to include?","plus_response":"I’d challenge whether the extra “coffee body scrub” kit is really necessary—if the basket already has coffee plus skincare, it might be redundant rather than meaningfully different. You could treat the planned items as the core (beans + cleanser) and only add something that fills a clear gap, like a matching reusable mug, a small treat, or a travel-size alternative she’ll actually use soon. If you go ahead with the scrub, check that it complements what she already uses (texture/scent/skin type) instead of adding another product she may not reach for.","minus_response":"A “coffee body scrub” kit could be a great add because it connects the coffee theme with skincare, turning the basket into a more complete pampering experience. If she enjoys both coffee and self-care, that extra product can feel like a premium upgrade rather than a cluttered afterthought—especially if the kit includes everything she needs for a consistent routine. Keeping the basket theme cohesive (coffee + skincare) also tends to make the gift feel more thoughtful and indulgent."}
